quotes.confounding: The patients who received TXA were younger, had more severe injuries overall and had significantly worse chest, pelvis and limb injuries than patients who had not received TXA
quotes.selection: We conducted a retrospective study of consecutive patients aged 18 years and over admitted to the East of England Major Trauma Centre (MTC)
quotes.classification: 333 patients were given TXA either pre-hospital or immediately following admission
quotes.deviations: TXA was administered to selected patients due to gradual integration of TXA into our MTN protocol during the study period.
quotes.missingData: Data describing demographics, the nature and extent of injuries, process of care, timing of PE prophylaxis and tranexamic acid (TXA) administration... were collected.
quotes.measurement: PE was defined as a filling defect within the pulmonary arterial system identified on CT imaging.
quotes.reporting: We report an overall incidence of PE of 48/1039 (4.6%)
